name: MySQL
subtitle: Relational database (SQL)
creator: Michael Widenius, David Axmark and Allan Larsson (MySQL AB)
license: GPLv2 community edition, plus commercial editions
description: A fast, widely deployed relational database and the M in LAMP. It powers much of the PHP web including WordPress. InnoDB is its default transactional storage engine, and Vitess and PlanetScale scale it horizontally.

concepts.explanation: Default engine with transactions and row locks.
Primary and replica copies for scale.
The full Unicode character set to use.

codeSamples.label: SQL

cons: Oracle stewardship led to the MariaDB fork
Historic quirks like utf8 vs utf8mb4

pricing.summary: Community edition is free. Oracle sells Enterprise editions; managed options are usage-based.
